name: order_esr
description: Orders an Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR) test. ESR measures how quickly red blood cells settle at the bottom of a tube, elevated in inflammation, infection, and autoimmune conditions.
when_to_use: Monitoring temporal arteritis or polymyalgia rheumatica
Suspected systemic inflammation or autoimmune disease

examples.query: Check sedimentation rate for giant cell arteritis workup

args.clinical_indication: new headache and jaw claudication, suspected GCA
